core_line: URAI handles the noise. You live the life.
source_intent: Cinematic onboarding film for /focus → Replay → login/create-world CTA.

scenes.title: Real Life Pressure
scenes.visual: Real person under pressure with alerts, reminders, unfinished tasks, and a meaningful photo/object nearby.
scenes.voiceover: Life does not wait for you to organize it.

scenes.title: Open URAI
scenes.visual: Tap URAI app, /home opens, camera pushes through phone into Home World.
scenes.voiceover: So URAI gives your life a world.

scenes.title: Orb Chat Doorway
scenes.visual: Tap orb. Orb unfolds into chat.
scenes.on_screen_text: Chat is the doorway. Your world is the interface.
scenes.voiceover: You can chat with URAI like normal AI — but chat is only the doorway.

ui_copy.user: Help me get my day under control.
ui_copy.assistant: I organized your signals. One needs your decision. Two can be handled quietly. One connects to a pattern from last month.

scenes.title: Self Avatar / Body State
scenes.visual: Tap self-avatar. Body/life-state layer appears with permission ring.
scenes.on_screen_text: Private body and life signals, controlled by you.
scenes.voiceover: With permission, URAI reflects your state so your world can respond.

scenes.title: Ground World / Private AI Workforce
scenes.visual: Walkable ground layer with council agents and real-life objects activating.
scenes.voiceover: On the ground, your private AI workforce helps handle the noise of real life.

scenes.title: Council / Models With Roles
scenes.visual: Council table, role badges, permission rings.
scenes.on_screen_text: Models with roles. Access with permission.
scenes.voiceover: Different models work together, each with a role, a boundary, and a purpose.

scenes.title: Sky Ascent
scenes.visual: Orb rises, camera ascends through clouds, tasks become paths and memories become stars.
scenes.on_screen_text: Above the work of life is the meaning of life.
scenes.voiceover: Above the work of life is the meaning of life.

scenes.title: Life Map
scenes.visual: Living galaxy with memories, chapters, people, places, and patterns.
scenes.on_screen_text: Your memories become a Life Map.
scenes.voiceover: Your memories, people, places, and patterns become a living map.

scenes.title: Relationship / Legacy Constellation
scenes.visual: Present friends, past friends, family, mentors, and protected legacy memory-presence nodes.
scenes.on_screen_text: Past, present, people, and legacy — connected inside your private world.
scenes.voiceover: Past, present, people, and legacy connect inside your private world. Legacy stays protected. Presence requires permission.

ui_copy.relationship_node: This person appears in nine memories, two places, and one turning point.
ui_copy.legacy_node: Legacy preserved: voice note, photo, story, place, lesson.

scenes.safety: No fake resurrection. Use artifacts, silhouettes, initials, places, lessons, and consent rings.

scenes.title: Focus Memory Seed
scenes.visual: Forest equation image becomes a living memory seed with Replay Memory button.
scenes.on_screen_text: One moment can hold an entire world.
scenes.voiceover: One moment can hold an entire world.

scenes.title: Replay Opens
scenes.visual: Still image becomes motion, camera enters memory, layers appear.
scenes.on_screen_text: Replay is not just watching. It is entering.
scenes.voiceover: Replay lets you step inside a memory, explore who and what shaped it, and understand what it meant.

scenes.title: Mirror + Passport Trust Montage
scenes.visual: Patterns become visible, then Passport Vault proves control and consent.
scenes.on_screen_text: Your life data belongs to you.
scenes.voiceover: Mirror shows the patterns your life keeps trying to tell you. Your world is private. Your data belongs to you. Every model needs permission.

scenes.title: Final CTA
scenes.visual: Return to phone. Person calm. CTA screen.
scenes.on_screen_text: Create your world. Step inside yourself.
scenes.voiceover: URAI handles the noise. You live the life. URAI is your private world for real life. Create yours. Step inside yourself.
